review.note: Retracted in M21: 10 July 1921, the Republican Liberals largest with 79 of 163 seats. It has one good argument out of it — the government it produced was the one murdered in the Noite Sangrenta three months later — but only that one, and nothing argued leads in. The massacre itself is already in the atlas and carries that story better than the ballot does.
